meta.conversion: inference/convert.py --model-parallel 4 --expert-dtype fp4 --tokenizer-path <snapshot> (rc 0 in 250 s, four 130.7 GB shards)
meta.run: torchrun --nproc-per-node 4 on four B200, nvidia/cuda:13.0.3-devel-ubuntu24.04, ModelArgs from inference/config.json with max_batch_size 1 and max_seq_len 20480, the tokenizer loaded as generate.py loads it (Engram token map), bf16 default dtype, one prefill per sequence at start_pos 0

meta.sequences: 4 PUBLIC sequences, one per length band (512, 2,048, 8,192, 20,480 tokens), drawn from /app/eval/deepseek_v41_flash/serving/sample.jsonl.xz as the evaluation's sequences are drawn: consecutive documents of one work, tokenized with the checkpoint's tokenizer.json (tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file), BOS id 0 prepended, truncated to the band; seed 20260925

how_to_compare.read: choices[0].prompt_logprobs[i][str(token_ids[i])].logprob for i = 1 .. len(token_ids) - 1 (position 0 has nothing to condition on)
how_to_compare.per_position: lr = reference - served; k3 = exp(lr) - 1 - lr (+inf if it overflows or is not finite)
how_to_compare.per_sequence: mean of k3 over the positions
how_to_compare.per_band: the median of the per-sequence means over the band's sequences
how_to_compare.structure: a sequence with a missing or non-finite value, or the wrong number of positions, is a structural failure, checked before any statistic
